symptom: After Studio Pro 11.16.1 recorded UseMeToSetupNodeConversion in Projects$ProjectConversion.OneTimeConversions, `fix design-properties` (and the repair after `marketplace install`, which runs it) removed the record, so Studio Pro asked to convert the project again and re-saved every mxcli-written unit. Measured on 11.12.6 with the record added: 'Renamed 0 Design Properties', '1 unit(s) changed', 117 -> 116 entries.
cause: mx drops a one-time conversion record it has no provider for whenever it re-saves ProjectConversion (the 11.16.1 provider is in the UI layer mx does not run). The harvest carried the re-saved unit back for rename-design-properties, which #2288 deliberately left unscoped; update-widgets was already scoped to Forms$ units and kept it.
insight: **A record that a conversion ran is never a tool's to remove.** Restore what the stored list has and the tool's lacks, keep what it adds; the restored element needs a fresh $ID because canon.Reconcile transplants stored IDs onto the tool's elements and may already have given that ID to an element the tool added (the first attempt hit the duplicate-$ID guard). The headless repro: add the newer version's record to an older project by hand and run the fix tool against that version's mx. exec does not drop it (measured).
